Explicit composition revision; preserve ALL accepted requirements and public output contracts unchanged. The prior revision still adds forwarding tasks, learned copying of already typed records, array field access and shape declarations absent from the producer. Replace that composition with the validated minimal reference plan below, adapted only to the accepted requirements and inspected operations. This is a generation example, not direct YAML or an execution approval.
Use Browser read cap_490d9e16075cbdca5954ec27, Document writer cap_37c513d225bb1b870053c5d3 and Browser close cap_bdb7ba9ab04b18783883fa86 (resolve its already inspected actual operation ID). The example aliases acquire/persist/release refer to those operations, not new capabilities. Keep the genuine business search, each product visit, observed extraction, actual Excel writing and cleanup. Search navigation may directly open the Amazon.fr search destination derived from the public query in an explicit transform; this avoids inventing a second control-selection workflow. No consent, unrelated actions, extra filtering/deduplication or scripted task kinds are part of the reference plan.
The Browser record schema has selector,text,href,group,kind,tag,role and optional reference/actions; it does NOT declare key,id,observed_order or href_seen. Use the exact observed selector as candidateKey (as in the reference) and lookup original records with port selector. Keep original typed record arrays with deterministic foreach exports; never extract to recopy them or invent an observed index/boolean. extract.each selection view is only candidateKey and observedText in an array per original page. The first lookup validates offered membership, the minimal verified_ids loop exports IDs, the second lookup yields original records directly as items of the effectful visit loop. lookup always returns records array, never field(lookup(...),href). Use field(item,href) inside visit. One-level flatten operates only on arrays of arrays. Do not use field(...,length), array indices or undeclared ports.
Adapt reconciliation to the accepted products record exactly (name, description, price, product_url, observed_error): a non-null object with nullable missing fields. Keep source errors and exact observed URL available in that existing compact transform. Export its whole typed product object directly from visit. The bounded formatting transform may return content plus the accepted non-null errors array based ONLY on observed nullable errors (omitting absent errors); no separate transformation to copy products or manufacture success. Return products directly from visit, xlsx_path from successful write.filePath, completed from verified write.success; required failed stages must fail locally. Preserve all accepted cardinalities, maximum ten, local completeness/success assertions, original order, repetitions and zero invented values. Keep the mapping target minimal and observed. No whole-snapshot interpretation, no new limits, helpers or task primitives. Do not keep extra forwarding stages from the invalid baseline.
